definition: a sweet dish served at the end of a meal
description: A young pastry chef in a white chef's jacket and a white bow tie stands at a marble counter in an ornate café. He holds a jug high and pours a thick stream of dark chocolate glaze over the top of a round sponge cake that sits on a white marble cake stand; the glaze runs down the sides. He smooths the top flat with a long palette knife, then pipes a chocolate signature across it from a paper piping bag. He slides a knife under a wedge and lifts it clear of the cake, showing the dark layers inside. In the last shot he holds a white plate up to the camera with the slice on it next to a tall swirl of whipped cream, smiling.
